skills.name: Hello and goodbye
skills.description: Match a spoken or written greeting to the picture of when it is used, e.g. 'buenos dias' goes with the sunrise and 'adios' with a waving child.

skills.name: Numbers 1 to 10
skills.description: Hear or read a number word from uno to diez and pick the group with that many objects, e.g. 'cinco' with five stars.

skills.name: Colours
skills.description: Pick the splash of paint that matches a colour word, e.g. 'rojo' with the red splash.

skills.name: Animals
skills.description: Match a Spanish animal word to its picture, e.g. 'el perro' to the dog and 'el gato' to the cat.

skills.name: Family members
skills.description: Choose the family picture that matches a word like 'mama', 'papa', 'hermano' or 'abuela'.

skills.name: Classroom objects
skills.description: Find the classroom object named, e.g. tap 'el lapiz' when you hear 'lapiz' among a book, a chair and a pencil.

skills.name: Simple commands
skills.description: Hear a classroom command such as 'salta' or 'sientate' and pick the picture of the action.

skills.name: Songs and rhymes
skills.description: Fill the missing word in a line of a familiar song or counting rhyme, e.g. 'uno, dos, ___, cuatro'.

skills.name: Saying my name
skills.description: Choose the right reply to 'Como te llamas?', e.g. 'Me llamo Ana', instead of an unrelated phrase.

skills.name: How I feel
skills.description: Match a face showing an emotion to 'estoy feliz', 'estoy triste' or 'estoy cansado'.

skills.name: Where Spanish is spoken
skills.description: Pick the flag or map pin of a country where people speak Spanish, e.g. Mexico or Spain, from a set of four.

skills.name: Party words and traditions
skills.description: Match festive words like 'pinata', 'fiesta' and 'musica' to their pictures.

skills.name: Numbers 1 to 20
skills.description: Read a number word from once to veinte and type or pick the numeral, e.g. 'quince' is 15.

skills.name: Days of the week
skills.description: Put the days from lunes to domingo in order, or say which day comes after 'martes'.

skills.name: Weather words
skills.description: Match a weather picture to the phrase, e.g. a sun to 'hace sol' and rain to 'llueve'.

skills.name: Favourite foods
skills.description: Match common foods to their pictures, e.g. 'la manzana' to the apple and 'el pan' to the bread.

skills.name: Parts of the body
skills.description: Tap the body part named in a 'Cabeza, hombros, rodillas y pies' style prompt, e.g. 'la nariz'.

skills.name: Clothes
skills.description: Pick the clothing item named, e.g. 'la camiseta' when shown a shirt, a hat and shoes.

skills.name: Please and thank you
skills.description: Choose the polite phrase that fits a scene, e.g. 'gracias' after receiving a gift or 'por favor' when asking.

skills.name: Yes and no answers
skills.description: Answer a simple question with 'si' or 'no' based on a picture, e.g. 'Es un gato?' showing a dog.

skills.name: Which picture?
skills.description: Hear a short description such as 'un gato negro' and pick the matching picture among four.

skills.name: Counting and colour songs
skills.description: Complete a line of a counting or colour song with the missing word, e.g. 'de colores, de colores se visten los ___'.

skills.name: How are you?
skills.description: Pick the natural reply to 'Como estas?', e.g. 'Muy bien, gracias', from a set of phrases.

skills.name: Saying my age
skills.description: Build the sentence 'Tengo siete anos' from word tiles to answer 'Cuantos anos tienes?'.

skills.name: Holidays and celebrations
skills.description: Match a celebration such as Dia de los Muertos or Las Posadas to its picture or key symbol.

skills.name: Foods from Spanish-speaking places
skills.description: Match a dish like tacos, paella or empanadas to its picture.

skills.name: Numbers to 100
skills.description: Read a number word such as 'cuarenta y dos' and type the numeral 42, or pick the word for a numeral.

skills.name: Months and dates
skills.description: Order the months from enero to diciembre or complete a date like 'el 5 de ___' from a calendar picture.

skills.name: Parts of the day
skills.description: Match 'la manana', 'la tarde' and 'la noche' to pictures of the sky or daily activities.

skills.name: Rooms and furniture
skills.description: Sort items such as 'la cama' and 'la estufa' into the rooms where they belong, e.g. dormitorio or cocina.

skills.name: Places in town
skills.description: Match a place word like 'la escuela' or 'el parque' to its picture on a town map.

skills.name: Sports and games
skills.description: Choose the sport named, e.g. 'el futbol' or 'la natacion', from pictures.

skills.name: El or la?
skills.description: Pick the article that goes with a familiar noun, e.g. 'la mesa' not 'el mesa'.

skills.name: One or many
skills.description: Choose the plural form of a noun when the picture shows several, e.g. 'gatos' for three cats.

skills.name: Me gusta / no me gusta
skills.description: Complete 'Me gusta ___' or 'No me gusta ___' to match a happy or sad face next to a food or activity.

skills.name: Where I am from
skills.description: Build 'Soy de Mexico' from word tiles to answer 'De donde eres?'.

skills.name: Labels and signs
skills.description: Read a short sign such as 'Salida' or 'Abierto' and pick what it means or where you would see it.

skills.name: Words that look alike
skills.description: Spot the Spanish word that means the same as an English word it resembles, e.g. 'elefante' and 'elephant'.

skills.name: Flags of Spanish-speaking countries
skills.description: Match flags to the names of countries such as Espana, Mexico, Colombia and Argentina.

skills.name: Music and dance
skills.description: Match a dance or instrument such as salsa, flamenco or the guitar to its picture or sound.

skills.name: School subjects
skills.description: Match subjects such as 'matematicas' and 'ciencias' to the pictures or items used in that class.

skills.name: Hobbies and activities
skills.description: Pick the activity phrase that matches a picture, e.g. 'leer' for a child reading or 'nadar' for swimming.

skills.name: Nature and seasons
skills.description: Sort words like 'el arbol', 'la flor', 'la nieve' into seasons or match them to pictures.

skills.name: Describing words
skills.description: Choose the adjective that fits a picture, e.g. 'grande' for a huge elephant or 'pequeno' for a mouse.

skills.name: Adjectives match the noun
skills.description: Pick the correct ending, e.g. 'la casa roja' not 'la casa rojo'.

skills.name: Mi and tu
skills.description: Complete a phrase with 'mi' or 'tu' based on who owns the object in the picture, e.g. 'mi mochila'.

skills.name: Soy, eres, es
skills.description: Pick the right form of ser for the subject, e.g. 'Yo soy alto' and 'Ella es alta'.

skills.name: Tengo and tienes
skills.description: Complete 'Yo tengo dos hermanos' or 'Tu tienes un perro' using tengo or tienes.

skills.name: All about me
skills.description: Build a short self-introduction from tiles: 'Me llamo Luis. Tengo nueve anos. Soy de Peru.'

skills.name: My family
skills.description: Choose the sentence that correctly describes a family picture, e.g. 'Mi hermana es pequena'.

skills.name: Short story details
skills.description: Listen to three or four simple sentences and answer who, what or where, e.g. 'Donde esta el gato?'

skills.name: Order the pictures
skills.description: Hear a short sequence of events and put three pictures in the order they were told.

skills.name: Holiday traditions
skills.description: Match a tradition such as the Three Kings' Day shoe or the twelve grapes at New Year to its celebration.

skills.name: A school day in another country
skills.description: Compare a school day in Spain or Mexico with your own by choosing true statements, e.g. 'la siesta es por la tarde'.

skills.name: Daily routine words
skills.description: Order routine phrases like 'me despierto', 'desayuno', 'voy a la escuela' into a sensible day.

skills.name: Transport
skills.description: Match vehicles such as 'el autobus', 'el tren' and 'la bicicleta' to pictures or to 'en' phrases.

skills.name: Shopping and money
skills.description: Read a price tag such as 'tres euros' or 'veinte pesos' and pick the correct numeral.

skills.name: Making plurals
skills.description: Type or pick the plural of a noun, adding -s or -es, e.g. 'lapiz' becomes 'lapices'.

skills.name: Un and una
skills.description: Choose the indefinite article for a noun, e.g. 'una silla' and 'un libro'.

skills.name: Noun then adjective
skills.description: Arrange tiles so the adjective follows the noun, e.g. 'el perro grande' not 'el grande perro'.

skills.name: Estar for location
skills.description: Complete 'El libro esta en la mesa' using esta or estan and a location word matching a picture.

skills.name: Hay: there is / there are
skills.description: Say what is in a picture using 'hay', e.g. 'Hay tres gatos en la casa'.

skills.name: Short paragraphs
skills.description: Read a four-sentence paragraph about a child and answer a detail question, e.g. 'Cuantos anos tiene Marta?'

skills.name: Menus and schedules
skills.description: Read a cafe menu or class timetable and find information, e.g. the price of 'jugo de naranja'.

skills.name: Question words
skills.description: Pick the question word that fits the answer, e.g. 'Donde?' for 'En la escuela' and 'Cuando?' for 'El lunes'.

skills.name: Ordering food
skills.description: Build a polite order such as 'Quiero una pizza, por favor' from tiles, in a sensible order.

skills.name: Countries and capitals
skills.description: Match countries to their capitals, e.g. Peru to Lima and Argentina to Buenos Aires.

skills.name: Famous landmarks
skills.description: Match a landmark such as Machu Picchu or La Sagrada Familia to its country.

skills.name: Continents and regions
skills.description: Sort Spanish-speaking countries into Europe, North America, Central America, the Caribbean and South America.

skills.name: Food and drink
skills.description: Sort food words into categories such as frutas, verduras, carnes and bebidas, or match words like 'la manzana' to pictures.

skills.name: Clothing and colours
skills.description: Match a described item such as 'la camisa azul' to the right picture, or sort items into ropa and colores.

skills.name: Classroom and school supplies
skills.description: Identify school objects such as 'el cuaderno' and 'la mochila' and say what is in a backpack.

skills.name: Family and pets
skills.description: Read a family tree and pick the right relationship word, e.g. 'la tia' for the mother's sister.

topics.name: Spanish basics: numbers, time and alphabet

skills.name: Numbers 0 to 1000
skills.description: Convert between number words and numerals, e.g. 'doscientos treinta y cinco' is 235, and sort numbers by size.

skills.name: Alphabet and spelling aloud
skills.description: Hear letters spelled out such as 'eme, a, ene, o' and pick or type the word 'mano'.

skills.name: Telling time
skills.description: Match a clock face to 'Son las tres y media' or 'Es la una menos cuarto'.

skills.name: Days, months and dates
skills.description: Write or pick a full date such as 'el quince de septiembre' from a calendar picture.

skills.name: Gender and articles
skills.description: Sort nouns into el and la, including patterns like -o/-a, -cion, -dad and exceptions such as 'el dia' and 'la mano'.

skills.name: Plural nouns and articles
skills.description: Change 'el libro' to 'los libros' and 'la luz' to 'las luces', choosing the matching plural article.

skills.name: Adjective agreement
skills.description: Make the adjective agree in gender and number, e.g. 'las chicas altas', 'los perros pequenos'.

topics.name: Spanish verbs: ser, tener and -ar verbs

skills.name: Forms of ser
skills.description: Match each subject pronoun to its form of ser, e.g. 'nosotros somos', 'ellos son'.

skills.name: Forms of tener and tener expressions
skills.description: Complete sentences such as 'Ellos tienen hambre' and 'Tu tienes doce anos' with the right form of tener.

skills.name: Present tense -ar verbs
skills.description: Conjugate regular -ar verbs like hablar, e.g. 'nosotros hablamos', 'ella habla'.

skills.name: Tu versus usted
skills.description: Choose the right greeting for the person, e.g. 'Como esta usted?' for a teacher and 'Que tal?' for a friend.

skills.name: Introducing others
skills.description: Build 'Te presento a mi amiga Sofia. Ella es de Chile.' from tiles in the right order.

skills.name: Classroom phrases
skills.description: Pick the phrase that fits the situation, e.g. 'Puedo ir al bano?' or 'No entiendo'.

skills.name: Mexico
skills.description: Answer facts about Mexico such as its capital, currency and a famous celebration, e.g. 'el peso'.

skills.name: Spain
skills.description: Match Spanish regions, foods and traditions to their descriptions, e.g. paella to Valencia.

skills.name: Mealtimes and customs
skills.description: Order the meals of a typical Spanish day with their times, e.g. 'la comida' around 2 pm and 'la cena' late.

skills.name: Present tense regular -ar, -er, -ir verbs
skills.description: Conjugate regular verbs for any subject and sort verbs by ending, e.g. 'comemos', 'viven', 'cantas'.

skills.name: Ser versus estar
skills.description: Choose ser or estar for a sentence, e.g. 'Ella ___ doctora' (es) and 'Ella ___ cansada' (esta), and sort uses by rule.

skills.name: Ir and ir a + infinitive
skills.description: Complete 'Yo voy al cine' or 'Vamos a estudiar' with the correct form of ir.

skills.name: Gustar and similar verbs
skills.description: Pick 'me gusta' or 'me gustan' depending on the noun, and the right pronoun, e.g. 'A el le gustan los deportes'.

skills.name: Forming questions
skills.description: Build a question from tiles with the right word order and question word, e.g. 'Donde vive tu abuela?'

skills.name: Negation
skills.description: Place 'no' correctly and use 'nunca', 'nada', 'nadie', e.g. 'No tengo nada'.

skills.name: Possessive adjectives
skills.description: Choose mi/mis, tu/tus, su/sus, nuestro/a/os/as to agree with the noun, e.g. 'nuestras casas'.

topics.name: Spanish vocabulary: home, school and town

skills.name: House and chores
skills.description: Match chores such as 'lavar los platos' to the room where they happen or sort furniture by room.

skills.name: School day and schedule
skills.description: Read a class schedule and answer 'A que hora tienes ciencias?' or match subjects to teachers.

skills.name: Places in town and activities
skills.description: Match a place like 'la biblioteca' or 'el mercado' to the activity you do there, e.g. 'leer' or 'comprar'.

skills.name: Telling time and making plans
skills.description: Answer 'A que hora?' with times like 'a las ocho y cuarto' and agree on a plan, e.g. 'Vamos al parque a las cinco'.

skills.name: Asking for and giving directions
skills.description: Follow directions on a simple map, e.g. 'Dobla a la derecha y sigue derecho', and pick where you end up.

skills.name: Short dialogues
skills.description: Listen to a two-person exchange at a shop or school and answer a comprehension question about it.

skills.name: Announcements and messages
skills.description: Hear a short school or train announcement and pick the key detail, e.g. the platform number or time.

skills.name: Texts and notes
skills.description: Read a short text message or note and choose the best reply or the main point.

skills.name: Ads and posters
skills.description: Scan a poster for a concert or sale and find the date, place and price.

topics.name: Spanish culture: Central America and the Caribbean

skills.name: Central America
skills.description: Match Central American countries to capitals, flags and a key fact, e.g. Costa Rica and its rainforests.

skills.name: The Spanish-speaking Caribbean
skills.description: Identify Cuba, Puerto Rico and the Dominican Republic on a map and match music such as salsa and merengue to origins.

skills.name: Sports in the Spanish-speaking world
skills.description: Match a sport such as beisbol or futbol to the countries where it is most popular.

skills.name: Stem-changing verbs
skills.description: Conjugate e>ie, o>ue and e>i verbs, e.g. 'quiero', 'puedes', 'piden', remembering nosotros does not change.

skills.name: Irregular yo forms
skills.description: Give the yo form of verbs like hacer, poner, salir, conocer and saber, e.g. 'hago', 'conozco'.

skills.name: Saber versus conocer
skills.description: Choose saber or conocer, e.g. 'Yo ___ a Maria' (conozco) and 'Yo ___ nadar' (se).

skills.name: Present progressive
skills.description: Describe what is happening now with estar + -ando/-iendo, e.g. 'Estamos comiendo'.

skills.name: Direct object pronouns
skills.description: Replace the object with lo, la, los or las and place it correctly, e.g. 'Compro el libro' becomes 'Lo compro'.

skills.name: Comparisons and superlatives
skills.description: Build comparisons with mas/menos ... que, tan ... como and 'el mas alto de la clase'.

skills.name: Prepositions of place and a/de contractions
skills.description: Choose 'al' or 'del' and location words, e.g. 'Voy al mercado', 'cerca del parque'.

topics.name: Spanish vocabulary: weather, travel and health

skills.name: Weather and seasons
skills.description: Match a forecast such as 'hace frio y nieva' to a picture and season, and say what to wear.

skills.name: Travel and transportation
skills.description: Sort words like 'el boleto', 'la maleta', 'el aeropuerto' by trip stage, or match them to pictures.

skills.name: Body and health
skills.description: Match complaints such as 'me duele la cabeza' to the body part and to a doctor's advice.

skills.name: Short stories and emails
skills.description: Read a one-paragraph email or story and answer main idea and detail questions.

skills.name: Guessing meaning from context
skills.description: Infer the meaning of an unfamiliar word from the surrounding sentence, e.g. 'bufanda' next to 'hace frio' and 'cuello'.

skills.name: Building complete sentences
skills.description: Arrange tiles into a correct sentence with connectors, e.g. 'Primero desayuno y despues voy a la escuela'.

skills.name: Accents and spelling
skills.description: Pick the correctly spelled word with accent marks, e.g. 'esta' versus 'esta', 'cancion', 'tambien'.

skills.name: Shopping and bargaining
skills.description: Pick the right line in a market exchange, e.g. 'Cuanto cuesta?' then 'Es muy caro', and compute change.

skills.name: Inviting, accepting and declining
skills.description: Match an invitation like 'Quieres ir al cine?' to a fitting response, e.g. 'Lo siento, no puedo'.

skills.name: Andean and Amazon countries
skills.description: Match Peru, Ecuador, Bolivia and Colombia to landmarks, foods and facts, e.g. Machu Picchu and quinoa.

skills.name: The Southern Cone
skills.description: Identify Argentina, Chile, Uruguay and Paraguay and traditions such as tango, mate and asado.

skills.name: Indigenous languages and words
skills.description: Match words of Nahuatl or Quechua origin such as 'chocolate' and 'papa' to their source languages.

skills.name: Preterite regular verbs
skills.description: Conjugate -ar, -er and -ir verbs in the preterite, e.g. 'hable', 'comimos', 'vivieron', noting accent marks.

skills.name: Preterite irregular verbs
skills.description: Give preterite forms of ir, ser, hacer, tener, estar, decir and spelling-change verbs, e.g. 'fui', 'hizo', 'busque'.

skills.name: Reflexive verbs
skills.description: Choose the reflexive pronoun and form, e.g. 'Me levanto a las seis', and decide reflexive versus non-reflexive ('lavo el coche' versus 'me lavo').

skills.name: Informal commands
skills.description: Form affirmative and negative tu commands, e.g. 'habla', 'no hables', 'pon', 'no pongas'.

skills.name: Indirect object pronouns
skills.description: Use me, te, le, nos, les with verbs like dar and decir, e.g. 'Le doy el regalo a mi madre'.

skills.name: Demonstratives
skills.description: Pick este, ese or aquel in the right gender and number based on distance in a picture, e.g. 'aquellas montanas'.

skills.name: Past time expressions and hace
skills.description: Match expressions like 'ayer', 'la semana pasada', 'hace dos anos' to a timeline position and to preterite sentences.

topics.name: Spanish vocabulary: routines, shopping and celebrations

skills.name: Daily routine and personal care
skills.description: Order a morning routine from 'despertarse' to 'salir de casa' and match items like 'el cepillo de dientes'.

skills.name: Clothing, sizes and shopping
skills.description: Match descriptions such as 'una falda de rayas, talla mediana' to pictures and complete a store dialogue.

skills.name: Celebrations and life events
skills.description: Sort vocabulary such as 'la boda', 'el cumpleanos', 'la quinceanera' with associated items and actions.

topics.name: Spanish reading: narratives in the past

skills.name: Stories told in the past
skills.description: Read a short narrative in the preterite and order the events or answer what happened first.

skills.name: Short biographies
skills.description: Read a short biography of a figure like Frida Kahlo and pull out dates and achievements.

skills.name: Recounting a weekend
skills.description: Listen to someone describe what they did last weekend and pick the activities in order.

skills.name: Short interviews
skills.description: Listen to a brief interview and identify the speaker's routine, preferences or plans.

skills.name: Writing about the past
skills.description: Assemble a five-sentence paragraph about yesterday using connectors like 'primero', 'luego', 'finalmente'.

skills.name: Editing for agreement and tense
skills.description: Spot and fix the error in a sentence, e.g. 'Ayer yo como pizza' should be 'comi'.

skills.name: Festivals across the Spanish-speaking world
skills.description: Match festivals such as La Tomatina, Inti Raymi and Carnaval de Barranquilla to countries and dates.

skills.name: Regional cuisine
skills.description: Match dishes like ceviche, arepas and tortilla espanola to their countries and main ingredients.

skills.name: Hispanic communities worldwide
skills.description: Answer facts about Spanish speakers in the United States and other countries, e.g. which US states have the most speakers.

skills.name: Imperfect tense
skills.description: Conjugate the imperfect, including ir, ser and ver, e.g. 'jugabamos', 'eran', 'veia', to describe habits in the past.

skills.name: Preterite versus imperfect
skills.description: Choose the tense for each verb in a story, e.g. 'Llovia (imperfect) cuando sali (preterite) de casa', and sort trigger words.

skills.name: Future tense
skills.description: Form the simple future, including irregular stems, e.g. 'viajare', 'tendran', 'haremos'.

skills.name: Formal and nosotros commands
skills.description: Form usted/ustedes commands and 'vamos a' or nosotros commands, e.g. 'Hable mas despacio', 'Comamos'.

topics.name: Spanish grammar: double pronouns and impersonal se

skills.name: Double object pronouns
skills.description: Combine indirect and direct pronouns, changing le to se, e.g. 'Se lo di' for 'Le di el libro a Juan'.

skills.name: Impersonal and passive se
skills.description: Complete signs and statements like 'Se habla espanol' and 'Se venden casas', choosing singular or plural.

skills.name: Adverbs and -mente
skills.description: Form adverbs from adjectives, e.g. 'rapida' to 'rapidamente', and place them in a sentence.

topics.name: Spanish vocabulary: environment, technology and work

skills.name: Environment and nature
skills.description: Sort words such as 'la contaminacion', 'reciclar', 'la selva' into problems, solutions and places.

skills.name: Technology and media
skills.description: Match terms like 'la pantalla', 'descargar', 'la red social' to definitions or icons.

skills.name: Professions and workplaces
skills.description: Match jobs such as 'la enfermera' and 'el ingeniero' to workplaces and tasks.

skills.name: Simplified news articles
skills.description: Read a short article and identify the main idea, a supporting detail and the author's purpose.

skills.name: Legends and folktales
skills.description: Read a legend such as La Llorona or El Dorado and sequence the plot or identify the moral.

skills.name: Infographics and data
skills.description: Read a Spanish infographic about recycling or screen time and extract numbers and comparisons.

skills.name: Talking about childhood
skills.description: Answer 'Que hacias cuando eras nino?' with imperfect sentences, e.g. 'Jugaba en el parque todos los dias'.

skills.name: Discussing future plans
skills.description: Build answers to 'Que haras el proximo verano?' using the future tense and time markers.

skills.name: At a restaurant
skills.description: Sequence a full restaurant exchange from being seated to paying, picking appropriate lines for each step.

skills.name: Narrating with two past tenses
skills.description: Assemble a story paragraph that uses imperfect for background and preterite for events in the right places.

skills.name: Transitions and connectors
skills.description: Choose connectors such as 'sin embargo', 'por eso', 'ademas' to link two sentences logically.

skills.name: Maya, Aztec and Inca
skills.description: Match achievements such as the Maya calendar, Tenochtitlan and Inca roads to the right civilization and region.

skills.name: Colonial era and independence
skills.description: Order key events from 1492 to the independence movements and match leaders such as Bolivar and Hidalgo to countries.

skills.name: Art and muralism
skills.description: Match artists such as Diego Rivera, Frida Kahlo and Fernando Botero to their styles and works.

topics.name: Spanish verbs: conditional, perfect and subjunctive

skills.name: Conditional tense
skills.description: Form the conditional, including irregular stems, e.g. 'me gustaria', 'podrias', 'harian', for polite requests and hypotheticals.

skills.name: Present perfect
skills.description: Combine haber with the past participle, including irregulars, e.g. 'he visto', 'hemos escrito'.

skills.name: Present subjunctive forms
skills.description: Conjugate the present subjunctive from the yo stem, including irregulars like sea, vaya, tenga and spelling changes.

skills.name: Subjunctive after wishes, emotions and doubt
skills.description: Choose indicative or subjunctive after triggers, e.g. 'Quiero que vengas' versus 'Se que vienes', and sort WEIRDO triggers.

topics.name: Spanish grammar: por/para, relatives and verbs like gustar

skills.name: Por versus para
skills.description: Choose por or para by meaning, e.g. 'Gracias por la ayuda' and 'Este regalo es para ti', and sort uses by rule.

skills.name: Relative pronouns
skills.description: Join two sentences with que, quien, lo que or donde, e.g. 'La chica que canta es mi prima'.

skills.name: Verbs like gustar
skills.description: Use faltar, importar, molestar, parecer with indirect pronouns and agreement, e.g. 'Nos faltan dos sillas'.

topics.name: Spanish vocabulary: society and global issues

skills.name: Community and volunteering
skills.description: Match words such as 'el voluntariado', 'donar', 'el refugio' to definitions and scenarios.

skills.name: Health and wellbeing
skills.description: Sort advice such as 'hacer ejercicio' and 'dormir ocho horas' into physical and mental health, and match symptoms to remedies.

skills.name: Idioms and expressions
skills.description: Match idioms such as 'estar en las nubes' or 'tomar el pelo' to their meanings.

skills.name: Authentic news and opinion
skills.description: Read an excerpt from a real newspaper or blog and distinguish fact from opinion and identify tone.

skills.name: Short fiction excerpts
skills.description: Read a passage from a short story and answer questions about character motivation and inference.

skills.name: Poetry
skills.description: Read a short poem by a poet such as Neruda or Mistral and identify imagery, theme and a figure of speech.

skills.name: Giving advice and recommendations
skills.description: Build advice with 'te recomiendo que' + subjunctive or 'deberias' + infinitive for a given situation.

skills.name: Expressing and supporting opinions
skills.description: Choose phrases like 'Creo que', 'No creo que' and the correct mood that follows each to state an opinion.

skills.name: Talking about what you would do
skills.description: Answer 'Que harias con un millon de dolares?' using the conditional in a complete sentence.

skills.name: Formal letters and emails
skills.description: Order the parts of a formal email and pick register-appropriate phrases such as 'Estimado senor' and 'Atentamente'.

skills.name: Summarizing a text
skills.description: Choose the sentence that best summarizes a paragraph without adding or distorting information.

skills.name: Literary figures
skills.description: Match authors such as Cervantes, Garcia Marquez, Allende and Borges to countries and major works.

skills.name: Music genres and origins
skills.description: Match genres such as reggaeton, cumbia, bachata and flamenco to their origins and instruments.

skills.name: Regional varieties of Spanish
skills.description: Identify features like vosotros, voseo and seseo and match regional words, e.g. 'guagua' for bus in the Caribbean.

topics.name: Spanish verbs: advanced subjunctive and compound tenses

skills.name: Imperfect subjunctive
skills.description: Form the imperfect subjunctive from the ellos preterite, e.g. 'hablara', 'tuvieran', 'fueramos', after past triggers.

skills.name: Si clauses
skills.description: Complete hypothetical sentences pairing imperfect subjunctive with conditional, e.g. 'Si tuviera tiempo, viajaria'.

skills.name: Pluperfect and conditional perfect
skills.description: Form 'habia comido', 'habria ido' and the perfect subjunctive to sequence past events.

skills.name: Subjunctive in adverbial and adjective clauses
skills.description: Choose mood after conjunctions like 'para que', 'cuando', 'aunque' and in clauses describing unknown antecedents, e.g. 'Busco un libro que sea interesante'.

topics.name: Spanish grammar: passive, register and nuance

skills.name: Passive voice and alternatives
skills.description: Convert 'La empresa construyo el puente' to 'El puente fue construido por la empresa' or to a se construction.

skills.name: Register and politeness
skills.description: Rewrite or pick phrases to shift from informal to formal register, e.g. 'Dame eso' to 'Podria darmelo, por favor?'

skills.name: Ser and estar with changing meaning
skills.description: Choose ser or estar where the adjective shifts meaning, e.g. 'es listo' (clever) versus 'esta listo' (ready).

skills.name: Reported speech
skills.description: Convert direct quotes to reported speech with tense shifts, e.g. 'Dijo: Vendre' becomes 'Dijo que vendria'.

skills.name: Literary analysis
skills.description: Read an excerpt from a novel or play and identify narrative point of view, symbolism and theme.

skills.name: Editorials and argument
skills.description: Read an editorial and identify the thesis, evidence and a counterargument, labelling each part.

skills.name: Historical and official documents
skills.description: Read a simplified historical speech or constitution excerpt and infer its purpose and audience.

skills.name: Podcasts and news reports
skills.description: Listen to a one-minute news or podcast clip and identify the main claim and two supporting details.

skills.name: Understanding regional accents
skills.description: Identify the likely region of a speaker from features such as vosotros, voseo or aspirated s, and understand the message.

skills.name: Debating and conceding points
skills.description: Pick phrases to agree, disagree and concede, e.g. 'Aunque es cierto que..., no estoy de acuerdo con...', in a structured exchange.

skills.name: Job and university interviews
skills.description: Choose appropriate formal responses to interview questions, e.g. 'Hableme de sus fortalezas'.

skills.name: Cultural comparison
skills.description: Build a comparison statement with 'mientras que' or 'a diferencia de' between two Spanish-speaking cultures and your own.

skills.name: Argumentative essay structure
skills.description: Order the parts of a persuasive essay and select the thesis statement that fits the given evidence.

skills.name: Integrating sources
skills.description: Choose the sentence that correctly cites a source, e.g. 'Segun el articulo, ...', without copying it word for word.

skills.name: Advanced editing
skills.description: Find and correct errors in mood, pronoun placement, accents and por/para in a paragraph.

topics.name: Spanish culture: the contemporary Spanish-speaking world

skills.name: Cinema
skills.description: Match directors and films such as Almodovar, del Toro and 'Roma' to countries and themes.

skills.name: Current affairs and institutions
skills.description: Identify institutions and issues such as the European Union, Mercosur and migration in the context of Spanish-speaking countries.

skills.name: Literary movements
skills.description: Place movements such as the Golden Age, modernismo and magical realism on a timeline and match representative authors.

skills.name: Spanish as a global language
skills.description: Answer facts about Spanish speaker numbers, Equatorial Guinea and the Philippines, and the role of the Real Academia Espanola.
